descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，在`cn-hangzhou`地域，查询共享权限名称为`AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch`，权限版本为`v1`的共享权限信息。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the information about the `AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch` permission whose version is `v1` in the `cn-hangzhou` region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcesharing get-permission --permission-name AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch --permission-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcesharing GetPermission --region cn-hangzhou --PermissionName AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch --PermissionVersion v1
